# authwise_provider (Data Source)

A way people sign in to a realm: username and password, a magic link, passkeys, a social or enterprise IdP, or SAML. `config` comes from the matching config data source. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `link_by_verified_email` (Boolean)
- `provider_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `provider_type` (String)
- `realm_id` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `trust_upstream_amr` (Boolean)
- `trust_upstream_email_verified` (Boolean)
- `upstream_acr_map` (Map of String)
